free_text: Despite the prior positive biopsy establishing an ISUP Grade Group 1 carcinoma, the rising PSA trend from 5.1 to 7.7 ng/mL warrants further investigation. The equivocal PI-RADS 3 and the PSA density of 0.11 ng/mL/mL, in the context of progression, suggest that a repeat biopsy is necessary to determine the current stage and guide management. The room converged on proceeding with a biopsy to clarify the disease status.
